scope: NMDOT traffic monitoring, roadway inventory, and planning GIS resources

decisions.title: NMDOT Traffic Data Management System Info Sheet
decisions.description: Explains how to search the NMDOT Traffic Data Management System by location or map, review AADT histories and volume, classification, speed, and weigh-in-motion counts, and access hourly, weekly, and monthly reports.

decisions.title: NMDOT Roadway Inventory System Data Dictionary and Metadata
decisions.description: Documents NMDOT's Roadway Inventory System database structure and metadata for linear-reference, route, traffic, pavement, bridge, safety, ownership, functional-class, and other roadway feature classes used in planning and reporting.

decisions.title: FHWA Model Inventory of Roadway Elements 2.1
decisions.description: Defines FHWA's national roadway and traffic data model, including 202 recommended elements, fundamental data requirements, collection methods, database relationships, maintenance guidance, and case studies supporting data-driven safety decisions.
